thread:
Aisha Patel: Quick update — we’re doing a small org adjustment in Eng Platform effective next Monday. Raj Malhotra will move into an advisory/enablement role focused on cross-platform integrations, and Tomás Rivera will step in as Eng Platform Manager (interim) while we run the search for the permanent hire. :tada:

Maya Chen: Thanks Aisha — big +1 to Raj for taking the advisory path, and congrats Tomás. Can you share transition notes?

Aisha Patel: Yep — Raj and Tomás put together a short handoff doc, link below. Key points: ownership of Dedicated autoscale policy, rollout of the new batching config, and oncall rotation updates. Please read before EoD Friday.

people-ops-bot: New doc created: /handbook/eng-platform/transitions/1853001234-eng-platform-handoff.md

Tomás Rivera: Appreciate it. I’ll schedule 1:1s with the team this week and do a quick triage on outstanding launch items. If anyone has blockers that need immediate attention ping me or DM.

Raj Malhotra: Happy to shadow Tomás for the next two weeks and be on-call for questions about the kernel-selection tests. I’ll also be available for partner handoffs.

Priya Singh: Heads up — two ICs on my PM roster (Kaitlyn + Omar) will shift to Platform for the duration of the Dedicated rollout to help with batching experiments. We’ll sync with Tomás on priorities.

Maya Chen: Thanks Priya — appreciate the extra support. People-ops: when do we start the formal backfill process for Raj’s previous slot?

Aisha Patel: We’re kicking off the req this week (internal first). Hiring handlers: @recruiting-eng please triage. I’ll add details to the req: level, scope, and must-have infra experience.

Tomás Rivera: For the team — please post any docs/PRs you think I should prioritize in #eng-platform by EoD Thursday. I’ll put together a public-facing status thread for customers next week.

Raj Malhotra: One quick note — the KV-cache rollout has a small perf regression in nightly for long-seq tests. I filed a bug and assigned to @infra-kernel. Link in handoff doc.

Priya Singh: Can we get a short Q&A this Friday 10am PT? People-ops, can you set up a 30m?

Aisha Patel: Scheduled — Friday 10:00–10:30am PT, Eng Platform all-hands channel. Invite sent. Agenda: transitions, handoff highlights, hiring timeline, and open Qs.

Maya Chen: Thanks everyone — smooth transitions make a huge difference. Huge thanks to Raj for the advisory commitment and congrats Tomás. :clap:

Tomás Rivera: Thanks team. Looking forward to getting up to speed.

people-ops-bot: Reminder set: Transition Q&A Fri 10:00 (30m) — calendar invites sent to participants.
